props.characteristic: the signal issues from a physical or biological process that would have run regardless of any intent to record it
props.positive_test: remove every human purpose and the process still runs and the signal still exists; an instrument stands between it and the record
props.negative_test: a human artifact or judgement arriving through an instrument is not natural -- the instrument is a channel, not an origin
props.examples: SDSS and LSST survey imaging; Protein Data Bank experimental structures; fastMRI raw k-space; Sentinel-2 imagery
props.notes: run A warned this value risks vacuity, since every photograph is a camera measurement; the test appeals to whether the capture pipeline is part of the source's identity

props.characteristic: human activity or artifacts produced for the actors' own purposes and collected afterwards
props.positive_test: the content would exist, unchanged, if this dataset had never been conceived
props.negative_test: fails if anyone was prompted, paid or instructed per item (elicited); curation and filtering do not change the origin -- selection is not origination
props.examples: Common Crawl and Wikipedia text; The Stack / GitHub code; Project Gutenberg; LAION and YFCC100M image-text pairs; MIMIC-III/IV clinical records; Criteo click logs; MovieLens and Netflix Prize ratings
props.notes: ABSORBS the byproduct-of-operation cases -- run B's `operational` and run A's three sub-cases -- by the owner's decision of 2026-10-08, which is run C's position. The clinician, the clicker and the rater are all acting for their own purposes and the record is collected afterwards, so the characteristic holds unchanged; what the fold gives up is the ability to separate them in a query. WATCH: revisit after #103's tests and after real annotations accumulate, to assess whether the value should be restored or a `collection channel` axis derived instead. A record emitted by a MACHINE rather than by a person fails this test and goes to `provenance-other`, which is where the evidence for that revisit collects

props.characteristic: the signal exists because the collection asked for it; a person or animal produced it to the collection's protocol
props.positive_test: there is a task description, protocol, prompt or payment that caused each item to be produced; remove the research request and the signal does not exist
props.negative_test: repurposed pre-existing human material stays human-incidental however aggressively it was filtered or reformatted
props.examples: ImageNet class labels; MS COCO annotations; SQuAD and SNLI; HH-RLHF preference comparisons; teleoperated robot demonstrations
props.notes: crowd versus expert is NOT a distinction on this axis -- annotation expertise is a separate characteristic. WIDENED by phase 2 from 'from people': runs A and B independently could not place `Neural Latents Benchmark` (macaque recordings during a trained reaching task) without overriding a test, and run A added ProteinGym. Animal behaviour, protocol ecology and phenotyping are a real slice of this corpus; the characteristic always turned on the ASKING, never on the species

props.characteristic: values computed by executing a human-written mechanistic model of a real referent
props.positive_test: there is a solver or engine whose parameters have physical units, and 'the simulation is wrong' is a meaningful complaint about the output
props.negative_test: fails when nothing outside the program is modelled (constructed); fails when a LEARNED model produced it (model-generated)
props.examples: OC20 / ANI-1x DFT energies; PDEBench solver outputs; CMIP6 climate runs; MuJoCo rollouts; CARLA and Habitat rendered observations
props.notes: absorbs `rendered` (graphics from authored assets), which only run A proposed and held with low confidence. The open alternative: one `program-computed` value plus a separate `referent` axis

props.characteristic: values determined by a formal construction, grammar or random procedure with no empirical referent
props.positive_test: the generating specification IS the ground truth; there is no measurement or approximation error to speak of
props.negative_test: fails when a real phenomenon is being approximated (simulated)
props.examples: dSprites and Shapes3D factor grids; Dyck-k and PCFG string sets; Erdos-Renyi and stochastic-block-model graphs; BBOB analytic test functions
props.notes: boundary with `simulated` flagged by all three runs; Habitat is the recurring hard case (laser-measured real interiors, then rendered)

props.characteristic: content produced by sampling or predicting with a trained statistical model
props.positive_test: a model checkpoint stands in the causal chain that produced the content, not merely scoring or filtering it
props.negative_test: model-based filtering, dedup or ranking does not count; a model consulted LIVE during the run is catalogued as a model, not as a source -- see SYNTHESIS.md section 4
props.examples: Self-Instruct / Alpaca; Cosmopedia and phi-style generated corpora; Noisy-Student pseudo-labels; AlphaFold DB predicted structures used as data
props.notes: open: whether a model-based SELECTOR (FineWeb-Edu, DataComp) injects this value. Run A recorded it and said 'selection is not generation'

props.characteristic: the signal is computed by a stated non-learned rule, verifier or engine
props.positive_test: a person could check the signal by applying a written rule, and the rule has no learned parameters
props.negative_test: fails if the producer has learned parameters (model-generated) or if a human judged case by case (elicited)
props.examples: unit-test pass/fail rewards; Lean or Coq proof checking; terminal outcomes from the rules of Go or chess; distant supervision by alignment to a knowledge base
props.notes: KEPT, and no longer speculative. Proposed by only one phase-1 run; all three phase-2 runs used it, and each reached a NON-GAME case from a name: `Juliet Test Suite` (A, B), `CFQ` (B), `CANUE` (A, C) -- a published index formula over administrative records -- and `IMDB-Wiki`, `ExtremeWeather` (C). The firm counts are small (A 9, B 12, C 4) but the characteristic held every time it was applied. Its live problem is NOT rarity: the counts swing to 40 (A), ~55 (B) and 37 (C) under a reward-channel reading, because a game supplies observations by construction and rewards by rule, and provenance has no channel to attach to. See SYNTHESIS.md section 6

props.characteristic: a generating process none of the above describes
props.positive_test: a reviewer can say what produced the signal and why no value fits
props.negative_test: not the case where the paper does not say -- that is the `unknown` coding state
props.examples: Google Borg and Alibaba cluster traces, and machine-emitted operational records generally -- no human activity produced them, so `human-incidental` does not hold; the hard candidate is an analog or quantum device whose output is both computed and measured
props.notes: the world/people/computation trichotomy is intended to be exhaustive, so this was expected to stay near-empty. It is NO LONGER expected empty: with the byproduct-of-operation value folded away, system telemetry has nowhere else to go, and the count that lands here is the measurement that decides whether that value is restored
